agents.result: `Tag.save` now returns `None`, `tag_create` in `tags/views.py` (the only caller that used the return value) now saves the tag and returns it itself, and all 3 tests pass; heads-up for the other branch: a one-line `tag_slug` like `Tag(name).save().slug` will break with an `AttributeError` once this lands, so it needs to save first and then read `tag.slug`.

I added `tag_slug(name)` in `tags/utils.py`; it saves the tag and returns its slug in one expression without using `save()`'s return value, so it will still work once the other engineer's change makes `save()` return `None`, and all 3 tests pass (though none of them exercises `tag_slug` itself).
